question: Please show the age of the driver who participated in the most number of races.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "drivers_attributes" AS SELECT siji_id, shuxing, shuxing_zhi FROM table_1
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "races" AS SELECT road, driver_id, pole_position, fastest_lap, winning_driver, winning_team, report, race_base, race_suffix FROM table_2

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH driver_age AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(siji_id AS INTEGER) AS driver_id,
    /* find index of 'Age' in attribute name list (0-based); returns NULL if not found */
    list_extract(shuxing, list_index(shuxing, 'Age')) AS age_entry
  FROM drivers_attributes
), driver_age_cast AS (
  SELECT driver_id,
         /* age may be stored as numeric or text inside the list; cast to INTEGER when possible */
         CAST(age_entry AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM driver_age
  WHERE age_entry IS NOT NULL
), participation_counts AS (
  SELECT driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT road) AS races_participated
  FROM races
  WHERE driver_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY driver_id
), top_driver AS (
  SELECT pc.driver_id, pc.races_participated,
         da.age
  FROM participation_counts pc
  LEFT JOIN driver_age_cast da USING (driver_id)
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pc.races_participated DESC, pc.driver_id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT age AS driver_age, races_participated
FROM top_driver;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH driver_age_idx AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(siji_id AS INTEGER) AS driver_id,
    /* position of 'Age' within attribute names */
    list_indexof(shuxing, 'Age') AS age_pos
  FROM drivers_attributes
), driver_age AS (
  SELECT da.driver_id,
         /* extract value from shuxing_zhi at same index */
         CAST(list_extract(d.shuxing_zhi, da.age_pos) AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM driver_age_idx da
  JOIN drivers_attributes d ON CAST(d.siji_id AS INTEGER) = da.driver_id
  WHERE da.age_pos IS NOT NULL AND da.age_pos >= 0
), participation_counts AS (
  SELECT driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT road) AS races_participated
  FROM races
  WHERE driver_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY driver_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT pc.driver_id, pc.races_participated, da.age,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pc.races_participated DESC, pc.driver_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM participation_counts pc
  LEFT JOIN driver_age da USING (driver_id)
)
SELECT age AS driver_age, races_participated
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH drivers_parsed AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(siji_id AS INTEGER) AS driver_id,
    /* Convert textual list representation to proper LISTs by stripping brackets and splitting on comma-space */
    /* Normalize by removing leading/trailing brackets and quotes, then split */
    /* attribute names */
    string_split(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(shuxing, '^\[|\]$', '', 'g'), '[\[\]']', '', 'g'), ', ') AS attr_names,
    /* attribute values as text */
    string_split(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(shuxing_zhi AS VARCHAR), '^\[|\]$', '', 'g'), '[\[\]']', '', 'g'), ', ') AS attr_vals
  FROM drivers_attributes
), driver_age_idx AS (
  SELECT 
    driver_id,
    list_indexof(attr_names, 'Age') AS age_pos,
    attr_vals
  FROM drivers_parsed
), driver_age AS (
  SELECT 
    driver_id,
    TRY_CAST(list_extract(attr_vals, age_pos) AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM driver_age_idx
  WHERE age_pos IS NOT NULL AND age_pos >= 0
), participation_counts AS (
  SELECT driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT road) AS races_participated
  FROM races
  WHERE driver_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY driver_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT pc.driver_id, pc.races_participated, da.age,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pc.races_participated DESC, pc.driver_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM participation_counts pc
  LEFT JOIN driver_age da USING (driver_id)
)
SELECT age AS driver_age, races_participated
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
